note: Generated from passages retrieved from the design document, then checked against those same passages by the lore critic. Corrections and the drafts they replaced are in critique/critique_log.json.

scorched_hull_panel.flavour: A sheet of somebody's outer wall, one side blackened. Light enough to tuck under an arm, cheap enough that nobody down there fights you for it.

bent_truss_section.flavour: Structural spar with a permanent kink in it, still solid where it counts. Low scrap off the cheap end of the band, and it knows it.

cracked_solar_array.flavour: The crack runs the whole panel and the cells hang on by their backing — snag it wrong on the tether and you will be hauling glitter. Cheap glitter, this low down.

dented_fuel_bladder.flavour: Emptied, folded, and stove in on one side. It rides light and it sells for about what an empty bag ought to, which is the price of the low country.

foil_insulation_bale.flavour: Someone's thermal blanket wadded and strapped into a bale. Bulk without much bite on the tether, and bottom-of-the-band money for the trouble.

collapsed_antenna_dish.flavour: Folded in on itself like a dropped umbrella and still wider than your cockpit. It hangs where the scrap is cheap, and it is all elbows on the tether the whole way down.

reaction_wheel_housing.flavour: A dense little drum of machined casing, heavier in the hands than it looks. Compact enough to stow easy, but it's still low-country scrap.

snapped_boom_arm.flavour: Broke clean at the joint and drifted off with the stub still attached. Awkward on the line, honest weight, and priced like everything else down here.

shattered_camera_mast.flavour: The optics head went first and the mast is holding its pieces together out of habit. Snatch it on the tether and there is nothing left to bring down — and this low, there was never much to bring down anyway.

battery_pallet.flavour: A strapped brick of dead cells on a frame. It pulls on the tether like a filing cabinet and pays like the low end of the envelope, which is to say barely.

torn_radiator_panel.flavour: Tore along the coolant channels and the fins flex if you so much as look at them. Handle it like a sheet of ice with a bill attached.

cryo_tank_girdle.flavour: The banded collar off a cold tank, thick-walled and stubborn. It came off something big and it hauls like it.

gyro_package.flavour: A sealed can of spun metal, all of its weight packed into no space at all. Small in the bay, felt on the way down.

docking_collar.flavour: A ring of latch hardware cut free of whatever it used to hold shut. Nothing delicate about it — just a lot of metal in a circle.

buckled_truss_node.flavour: Where six spars met, now a knot of bent metal that won't lie flat in the bay. Heavy enough to argue with the tether the whole trip.

optics_bench.flavour: A mounting slab with the alignment glass still seated in it, and that glass is the whole reason to be careful. One hard swing and you are hauling a slab with nothing on it.

deployable_mast_cassette.flavour: A drum with a hundred metres of mast still coiled inside it, seized halfway out. Solid, mean, and it takes up more room than anything has a right to.

ion_thruster_cluster.flavour: Four grids and their plumbing on a common mount, burnt through and welded together by heat. Dense little package, and it drags like it means it.

cracked_pressure_dome.flavour: An endcap off a crew can with a fracture wandering across it. Half a tonne of hull that will finish splitting if you dock it hard — and up here that is real money to drop.

reactor_shield_plug.flavour: A stub of dense shielding the size of a stool, and it hauls like the whole reactor came with it. Rich metal from the expensive end of the band.

comsat_bus_frame.flavour: The skeleton of a whole satellite with its guts still bolted in. Nearly a tonne of dense hardware from the top of the envelope, and it fights you every metre down.

telescope_mirror_segment.flavour: A tonne of ground glass on a backing frame, still holding its figure. It is worth the climb and it will shatter into worthless dust if you bring it in rough.

isotope_cask.flavour: A squat shielded drum that outweighs three of you and takes up the space of one. High-country payday, and your tank will notice every metre of it.

solar_wing_spine.flavour: The full backbone of an array wing, panels stripped, still longer than your ship. It comes off the rich end of the band and it fights you on the tether and the whole way down.

scorched_reentry_cone.flavour: Something big came down wearing this once and it is charred through, the ablative crumbling wherever you grip. The heaviest thing you can get a tether on short of the module itself, and the one most likely to come apart on the way to the deck.
